column8: Stable table group identity and one-group metadata are covered; TiKV table-prefix encoding and PD interaction remain outside the dependency-closed leaf.
Partition group IDs, physical partition IDs, deterministic ordering, and duplicate collapse are covered; table metadata and codec/PD lifecycle remain open.
Missing partition-definition validation is covered as a typed metadata error; source catalog-corruption context and DDL error plumbing remain open.
